decisions.reason: As a close-to-core system that stayed prominently presented after launch, it likely met aspiration levels well enough and benefits from the firm's growth, installed-base logic, and lifecycle-service model.

Although less prominently marketed, it survived the initial post-launch review that eliminated other items and likely remains a useful complementary component within the firm's broader formwork and automation offering.

Its dedicated product-page presence suggests stronger perceived demand and strategic fit, so under boundedly rational management it would likely be retained unless results clearly fell below aspiration.

This product has the highest risk among the survivors because it appears less prominent and may overlap with adjacent magnetic formwork items, but the firm's expansion and available slack still make retention more likely than withdrawal.
